claims.statement: If D_n is the complete physical L+Q packet for the genuine one-point-defect q_n and Gamma_n^D=D_n-D_{n-1}/2, then for every N>=3, D_N=2^{-(N-2)}D_2+sum_{n=3}^N 2^{-(N-n)} Gamma_n^D. Using the contributor-proved B19 signs, every internal summand is negative, so the positive weighted terminal packet is indispensable.
claims.quantifiers: All integers N>=3; canonical physical restriction chain of the genuine Boolean one-point-defect family; entropy in bits.
scope_exclusions: Does not prove the universal terminal-budget inequality.
Does not refute globally chosen trees or signed multistep cancellation.
The B19 full-credit sign still needs a fresh independent reviewer.
